scripts.dev:electron: corepack pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-dev.mjs
scripts.prepare:workspace-surfaces: corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/kit build
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:workspace-surfaces && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:electron: pnpm run prepare:workspace-surfaces && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-electron-preload.mjs
scripts.pack:release-evidence: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/pack-release-evidence.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:electron: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node --test test/electron-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:electron:live-runtime: corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/avatar build:renderer && corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/avatar build:electron && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node --import tsx --test test/electron-live-runtime-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:electron:real-local-agent: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node --test test/electron-real-local-agent-acceptance.mjs
